title: to go foil rounds
text: to go foil rounds. We use these at our annual seafood boil for family to take home their choice of left overs.  Works great!  I have been purchasing these for several years and I will continue to do so.  They are foil with a clear top lid.  The foil bottom is not terribly thick, so you want to hold underneath. But they certainly do get dry food home in the cooler.  Not really suitable for juicy, more liquid food as you can't really seal them.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope this info was helpful to you!
